synopsis: Tim Kelly developed Goal Structuring Notation (GSN) in the 1990s; Chapter 12 cites Kelly (1998) and the GSN Community Standard version 3 (2021) for a notation that connects contextualized goals, strategies, sub-claims and evidence [f12250, f9705]. Kelly's safety-case management approach appears in documented practice as an instrument for linking a roadmap to evidence, and safety-case-driven planning is associated with Kelly 1998 and UL 4600 [f9814, f10112]. For the heavy off-road collision mitigation validation plan, the corpus recommends Kelly's step-by-step argument review (2007) as a suitable source of structure [f9985]. This endorsement sits within a broader disagreement: Kelly and UL 4600 favor safety cases, whereas Haddon-Cave on Nimrod, Leveson and Graydon criticize them [f10319].
